answer: In PoA, each challenge task commits to a future drand threshold-BLS beacon pulse, while its nonce and response are bound through a commit-reveal transcript. Because the pulse is unpredictable and computationally unbiasable until quorum signatures finalize it, an automated sybil swarm cannot precompute valid answers, farm offline, or select favorable rounds. Whether labeled falcon, onyx, or gale, every agent must spend scarce resources after the beacon arrives, making identities costly to multiply.
